answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The prism holds work receipts rather than names, so the raven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
